description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'FormatWithJobTitleTest' that tests the 'FormatWithJobTitle' class responsible for formatting or retrieving employee job titles within the OrangeHRM system. The test includes setup code that loads fixture data and verifies the behavior of the GetFormattedValue method.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitleTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that verifies the behavior of the FormatWithJobTitle class, especially its getFormattedValue method.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by loading fixture data and instantiating the FormatWithJobTitle object.

methods.name: testGetFormattedValue
methods.description: Tests the getFormattedValue method of the FormatWithJobTitle class for specific employee IDs.
